leadText:
Pokémon Advanced Battle is the opening theme song for the dub of the eighth and ninth seasons of as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from AG093 to AG191.

The opening animation for the eighth season featured footage from the eighth English opening, Unbeatable, and clips from various episodes of the season. The opening animation for the ninth season additionally featured footage from the ninth English opening, .

Pokémon Advanced Battle (song)
Category:Italian opening themes
Pokémon Advanced Battle is the opening theme song for the dub of the eighth and ninth seasons of as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from AG093 to AG191.

The opening animation for the eighth season featured footage from the eighth English opening, Unbeatable, and clips from various episodes of the season. The opening animation for the ninth season additionally featured footage from the ninth English opening, .
